init_prevalence: create a Prevalence instance to compute factor prevalence and misclassification shifts for ImageNet-X models
compute_metaclass_prevalence: compute the prevalence proportion of each factor per metaclass from ImageNet-X annotations
compute_metaclass_prevalence_shift: compute the relative prevalence shift of each factor per metaclass compared to overall prevalence
compute_metaclass_misclassification_shif: compute the misclassification shift per metaclass for a given model and merge with accuracy
compute_misclassification_shift: compute the aggregate misclassification shift across all factors for a given model
